title: Build an Async Integration Endpoint
prompt:
Create an async view that calls external services concurrently, with timeouts, error handling, and adapters for sync-only operations.

Submission: a small reviewable artifact, relevant tests, expected outputs, one failure/boundary case, and version/environment notes. Use synthetic data. Django/Python server code is not executed by CodeLeaf browser preview; local or human review is required.
target_skills: Use bounded timeouts and handle partial dependency failure.

starter.content:
import asyncio

async def fetch_status(client):
    async with asyncio.timeout(2):
        return await client.get_status()
starter.code:

expected_output: Use a local fake async client in testing; do not depend on live service credentials.
acceptance_criteria: The endpoint handles a dependency timeout.
Concurrency is bounded and failures produce explicit responses.
The design notes the deployment interface and library compatibility.
State whether verification was local, static, or human-reviewed.
Do not claim a build/deployment or external integration was tested unless it was actually run.
hints: Only use async I/O clients that support it.
Do not assume transactions are async-safe.
Keep concurrency bounded to protect external services and your worker capacity.
grading_method: Required-string smoke check plus human review of technical correctness, tests, safe handling, expected result and reproducibility. This does not execute arbitrary Python/Django code.
retry_policy: Retries are allowed after reviewing feedback; the platform backend owns its uniform XP/idempotency rules.
